title: Data-Efficient Reinforcement Learning with Self-Predictive Representations

methods.one_paragraph_description: SPR (Self-Predictive Representations) trains a Rainbow/DQN agent with an auxiliary self-supervised loss: an online encoder produces latent states, a learned transition model predicts latent representations K=5 steps into the future given actions, and predictions are matched (cosine loss via projection/prediction heads) to targets from a target encoder that is an exponential moving average of the online encoder. With augmentation (random shifts + intensity), tau=0 (target = online encoder); without augmentation, tau=0.99 and dropout 0.5. Total loss = RL loss + 2 * SPR loss. The paper reports both 'SPR' (with aug) and 'SPR (no Aug)'.
methods.conventional_lineage_hint: self-supervised representation learning for sample-efficient model-free deep RL from pixels ('augment reward maximization with self-supervised objectives'); Rainbow-based (van Hasselt et al. 2019 data-efficient Rainbow)
